title: K-Moduli Wall Crossing and Automorphic Forms for the Moduli Space of Rational Elliptic Surfaces
summary: Using K-moduli spaces for log quasimaps $q_t\colon\left(\mathbb P^1,\frac{1-t}{12}D\right)\to[\mathbb A^2/\mathbb G_m]$ of degree twelve with twelve points and weight $t/12$, we construct a modular interpolation $\{\mathcal M_t\}_{0\le t\le1}$ between the Baily--Borel compactification of the Heckman--Looijenga ball quotient $X_o$ and Miranda's GIT compactification of the moduli space of rational elliptic surfaces.
